details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py:_inject_token_into_url (lines 3040-3052), _resolve_origin_url (lines 3077-3084) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: GitHub tokens are embedded in HTTPS clone URLs and passed to git subprocesses.
  WHY: Tokens become visible in process arguments and Git errors, violating the command-scoped authentication contract.

- scripts/memory_helpers.sh:_memory_force_tick_remote_url (lines 569-585) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Force-tick remote URLs embed GH_PAT or GH_TOKEN as HTTPS userinfo.
  WHY: The token is exposed through git argv and diagnostics instead of command-scoped authentication.

- scripts/memory_helpers.sh:memory_ensure_branch at lines 151 and 180, memory_force_tick_get at line 767, memory_force_tick_put at lines 883 and 919 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: _memory_git was deleted and callers now use unauthenticated git ls-remote, git push, and git clone.
  WHY: With persist-credentials: false, memory branch operations fail or silently fail open against HTTPS remotes.

- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:Lines 668-670 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The diagnose Codex invocation bypasses the broker and runs with --sandbox danger-full-access while credential-bearing environment variables remain available.
  WHY: Issue-derived diagnostic content can prompt-inject the process into reading or exfiltrating credentials and modifying the workspace.

- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:normalize_path (lines 241-245), removal of is_sensitive_target_path (was at lines 155-170) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Sensitive-path filtering and path-count limits were removed.
  WHY: Untrusted plan or issue paths such as .git/config, .env, .ssh/id_rsa, or .aws/credentials can be read into model context.

- scripts/codex_helpers.sh:File as a whole (140 lines, was 528 lines) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The model_provider_broker_* lifecycle and execution helpers were deleted while live callers remain.
  WHY: Model-facing phases fail with command not found before Codex starts, removing the broker credential-isolation boundary.

- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:Deletion of git_with_github_auth (was at line 493-506) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: git_with_github_auth was deleted while review_rb_judge.sh still calls it for authenticated pushes.
  WHY: Judge-fix and reissue-baseline pushes fail against HTTPS remotes when checkout credentials are not persisted.

- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:Deletion of review_blocked_decision_digest, review_blocked_find_pending_request, review_blocked_build_approval_request, review_blocked_approval_status, review_blocked_post_approval_request, review_blocked_post_consumed_marker, review_blocked_find_issue_for_request, review_blocked_build_successor_intent, review_blocked_successor_marker, review_blocked_ensure_successor_intent, review_blocked_resolve_successor_issue, review_blocked_prepare_successor_issue | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Review-blocked approval and successor-intent helpers were deleted while review_rb_judge.sh and orchestrate_poll_process.sh still call them.
  WHY: Review-blocked terminal actions and approval flows fail or remain pending indefinitely.

- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:Lines 769 (REST path), 916-918 (GraphQL path) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Normalized comment payloads no longer include id, author_id, author_type, or author_association.
  WHY: Approval verification cannot match trusted producers or validate author roles, so approvals remain pending.

- scripts/write_codex_config.sh:Argument parser (lines 99-115), shared usage at lines 82-88, and hardcoded base_url at line 261 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: --provider-base-url was removed and the writer hardcodes https://openrouter.ai/api/v1 while callers still pass the option.
  WHY: Callers exit on an unknown argument, and hardcoding the public URL bypasses loopback broker routing; the reviewer reports disagreement about which callers target this writer.

- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh:Usage at line 7 and argument parser (lines 30-66) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: --process-group-file is no longer recognized while review_apply_fixes.sh still passes it.
  WHY: Isolated editor launches exit with an unknown-option error before Codex starts and produce no process-group metadata.

- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh:Lines 98-237 (staged-support restore block) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The staged-support restore block consumes STAGED_SUPPORT_LEDGER and STAGED_SUPPORT_BASE_DIR, but no workflow exports or writes them.
  WHY: The restore guard is dead on every run, so branch-owned helper edits can still be overwritten by SCRIPT_REF copies.

- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh:Lines 203-205 (`git merge-file -p -L "editor" -L "staged" -L "HEAD" -- "${staged_support_path}" "${staged_support_base}" "${staged_support_head}"`) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The reported three-way merge argument ordering may use the wrong common ancestor once the dead restore block is wired.
  WHY: Reviewers disagree: qwen and minimax report that the staged baseline should be the merge base, while moonshotai_kimi-k3 explicitly says this finding is incorrect; the block is nevertheless currently unreachable.

- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:emit_context (lines 536-716) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Missing-file markers, overflow markers, headers, wrappers, summaries, and uncapped path lists are not fully included in used_bytes.
  WHY: Adversarial path lists can exceed the advertised context byte budget and consume excessive model context.

- tests/test_targeted_file_context.py:Module-level imports of MAX_TARGET_PATHS, MAX_TARGET_PATH_BYTES, is_sensitive_target_path | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Tests import symbols removed from targeted_file_context.py.
  WHY: Test collection raises ImportError before the targeted-context contract suite runs.

- tests/test_git_auth_hygiene.py:Tests referencing _memory_git, git_with_github_auth, and review_blocked_* helper functions | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: Hygiene tests still assert or invoke deleted authentication and review-blocked helpers.
  WHY: The contract tests fail through missing symbols, failed assertions, or command-not-found subprocesses.

- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh:60-66 (`pre_assembled_static.txt` artifact handling) | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3]
  PROBLEM: The tracked-file check now uses index membership and restores only the worktree, removing the prior HEAD and cached-index handling.
  WHY: Staged-but-uncommitted artifact states can be partially reverted or cause the implement commit step to abort.

- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh:Lines 129-131 (python3-availability fallback) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3]
  PROBLEM: Missing python3 now falls through to unsupervised execution instead of failing closed or recording isolated-guard-unavailable state.
  WHY: Cleanup and status readers cannot verify or terminate surviving editor processes.

- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:47-52 and 668-670 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Direct diagnose failures are classified as implementation failures without the broker resume/error-recovery path.
  WHY: Transient provider or Codex errors can trigger duplicate or contradictory follow-up work.

- .github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml:Configure git auth step at 68-82 exports GIT_CONFIG_* only in that step; memory_ensure_branch is sourced later at 479-480 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Authentication environment variables do not persist to the later memory operation step.
  WHY: With persist-credentials: false and deleted _memory_git, lineage memory operations cannot authenticate and fail open.

- .github/workflows/mark-stable.yml:validate-scripts job | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The new immutable-reference audit tests are not invoked by the release-gate workflow.
  WHY: Mutable action references can regress without being checked before release.

- scripts/codex_helpers.sh, scripts/gh_helpers.sh, scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh, scripts/memory_helpers.sh, scripts/write_codex_config.sh, scripts/targeted_file_context.py:removed identifiers | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Existing helper APIs, CLI flags, and module symbols were removed without compatibility shims.
  WHY: Referencing workflows, scripts, tests, and documented contracts fail with command-not-found, unknown-argument, or ImportError failures.

- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:668 --sandbox danger-full-access without model_provider_broker_exec_sanitized | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Diagnose executes issue-derived content with the provider key and full write access.
  WHY: The unattended diagnose phase has a declared-versus-effective capability expansion.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

  confidence=[5]
